SELECT bucket AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN hours < 1 THEN '<1h' WHEN hours < 4 THEN '1-4h' WHEN hours < 24 THEN '4-24h' WHEN hours < 72 THEN '1-3d' WHEN hours < 168 THEN '3-7d' ELSE '7d+' END AS bucket FROM ( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.create_time, MIN(lg.create_time)) / 60.0 AS hours FROM sale_lead t INNER JOIN crm_lead_log lg ON lg.lead_id = t.id AND lg.log_type = 2 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY t.id, t.create_time ) AS lead_hours WHERE hours IS NOT NULL ) AS bucketed GROUP BY bucket

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(hours), 2), 0) FROM ( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.create_time, MIN(lg.create_time)) / 60.0 AS hours FROM sale_lead t INNER JOIN crm_lead_log lg ON lg.lead_id = t.id AND lg.log_type = 2 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY t.id, t.create_time ) AS h

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.create_time, lg_first.convert_at) / 24.0), 2), 0) FROM sale_lead t INNER JOIN ( SELECT lead_id, MIN(create_time) AS convert_at FROM crm_lead_log WHERE log_type = 4 GROUP BY lead_id ) lg_first ON lg_first.lead_id = t.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND lg_first.convert_at >= #{start} AND lg_first.convert_at <= #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sale_lead t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%m-%d'), DATE(t.create_time) ORDER BY DATE(t.create_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sale_lead t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(convert_at, '%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT t.id, MIN(lg.create_time) AS convert_at FROM sale_lead t INNER JOIN crm_lead_log lg ON lg.lead_id = t.id AND lg.log_type = 4 WHERE t.deleted = 0
GROUP BY t.id HAVING convert_at >= #{start} AND convert_at <= #{end} ) AS c GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(convert_at, '%m-%d'), DATE(convert_at) ORDER BY DATE(convert_at)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(convert_at, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT t.id, MIN(lg.create_time) AS convert_at FROM sale_lead t INNER JOIN crm_lead_log lg ON lg.lead_id = t.id AND lg.log_type = 4 WHERE t.deleted = 0
GROUP BY t.id HAVING convert_at >= #{start} AND convert_at <= #{end} ) AS c GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(convert_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label
